name: RipTides Cocktails and Grill

evidence.note: Official site: address, hours, side-door accessible entrance, street parking.
Band's event: Wicked Games annual Octoberfest Jam at Riptides in Lindenhurst, Sat Oct 3, 7:30 pm.
Yelp review excerpt mentions spending a night listening to the live band Wicked Games; no mention of dancing.

dancing.notes: Rock and party bands like Wicked Games play here, but we could not confirm how much room there is to dance. Check with the bar.

description: A laid-back cocktail bar and grill on Montauk Highway in Lindenhurst serving seafood and bar food, with local party bands on some nights.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Confirmed as the Lindenhurst Riptides because the band's own Oct 3 event names Riptides in Lindenhurst. One event listing shows 172 9th Ave, West Babylon, which looks like a map error. Website domain now ends in 'grills.com'; older listings use riptidescocktailsandgrill.com. Ira listed this gig twice (duplicate line).

Directory research 2026-10-04: Site says it is owned by American Sherpa, which explains the americansherpatours.com email. Accessible entrance at the side door; street parking nearby (per the site). Current description is still accurate. Photo 1 is a very large original (5719 px, about 10 MB) - resize before use.
hours: Mon 3 PM-12 AM; Tue-Sun 2 PM-12 AM
